summary: Package fetches remote code from a GitHub Gist and eval()s it on require
details: On load, index.js issues an HTTPS request to api.github.com/gists/7676451d2f972137d2482c4a8937a77a, extracts the file content from the response, and passes it directly to eval(). The Gist is mutable and controlled by the account 'aiverticalsolutions', so any require() of this package executes whatever JavaScript that account currently has in the Gist, with the privileges of the Node.js process performing the import. There is no pinning, integrity check, or sandboxing around the fetched content.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
